name: Feather Token (Fan)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Use
powers.text: On a boat, it becomes a giant fan that drives the vessel for 8 hours.

summary: On a boat, it becomes a giant fan that drives the vessel for 8 hours.
text: A one-use, feather-shaped token. Aboard a boat or ship, toss it up to 10 feet into the air as a Magic action: it vanishes and a giant fan appears, hovering and flapping. Its wind fills the sails of one vessel and adds 5 miles per hour to that vessel's speed for 8 hours. A Magic action dismisses the fan.
